envNotes: Helm release srw: rev 4679 completed before the run; Tilt then upgraded to rev 4680 with unchanged image tags, deployed 17:03Z. Not touched.
Node DNS hand-patch held: the node's image cache was empty after the outage and every workspace image pulled from srw-registry:5000 within 15-45 s.

The Playwright MCP couldn't start: its profile mcp-chrome-d399508 is held by a Chrome owned by a Codex app-server's playwright-mcp (not this session). UI checks ran on a private headless Chromium 147 over CDP (port 9333) with Node Playwright scripts; stopped at the end.
Host swap full throughout; no command was OOM-killed.
MiniMax-M3 was disabled for about 10 s to make the A9 draft create fail, then re-enabled (verified enabled=t).

Ending Session af1e0c6a-... hung: 503 'Workspace resident retirement is not yet acknowledged'; log 'Terminal-fenced terminal rclone cleanup terminal_unmount_srw-af1e0c6a-home.sh failed with exit code 88'; /cloud/home was a dead rclone FUSE mount with no rclone process. After umount -l /cloud/home in the pod: End 200, permanent delete 503 then 200. Not A3 (see outOfScopeFindings[1]).
Two pool agent pods (srw-agent-j-5e290124, srw-agent-j-d07c5668) created by the dispatcher at 17:13Z, ready and reused by the later jobs, left to the provisioner (MIN_AGENTS 0).

outOfScopeFindings.what: The landing draft can pick another user's personal project for an admin
outOfScopeFindings.evidence: persistent-chat.service.ts retryDraftDefaults (since 23256ab30, 2026-09-14) uses projects.find(is_default) on GET /api/projects?status=active. For the admin that list contains every user's personal project (dev-user-1's 5e024234-... comes before test's c325de45-...). In the prod-serve harness the draft sent project_ids [5e024234-...] and got 403 'One or more attached projects are unavailable'; on https://localhost in this run it picked c325de45-... (likely the view-as mode/header differs). Not changed by A3.

outOfScopeFindings.what: A dead rclone FUSE mount blocks stateless Session retirement
outOfScopeFindings.evidence: see envNotes; the unmount script exits 88 while the mount entry remains
